title: Mechanical to Electrical Position
text: Compute electrical position of rotor from mechanical position, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Input data type} sets Data type of input ports; {Pole pairs input} sets the method to specify number of pole pairs available in motor Specify via, {Number of pole pairs}, {Input mechanical angle unit} sets the unit of mechanical position of rotor Per, {Offset input type} sets the method to specify offset and {Mechanical offset} sets the value of mechanical position offset. Values come from the instance.
